information_architecture.overview: Consolidate 5 separate screens into 3 distinct functional pillars to reduce cognitive load and separate base valuation (price) from transient rules (offers).

conceptual_separation.price_vs_discount: Visually separate 'Base Pricing' and 'Promotions'. Price Book is designed as a strict, dense financial ledger (tabular, monospace numerals, focus on margins/costs). Promotions uses a more visual, rule-based card layout (focus on dates, badges, conditions) to make it clear that offers are temporary layers on top of base prices.
conceptual_separation.eoss_vs_offers: EOSS Planning acts as an advanced 'Generator' tool inside the Promotions section. When an EOSS markdown ladder is approved, it outputs standard rules into the 'Active Offers' tab, tagged as [EOSS]. It is a workflow, not a separate entity type.

typography.headings: Cabinet Grotesk or system sans-serif (Inter), semibold, tight tracking. Color: text_primary.
typography.body: Inter or system sans-serif, regular. Color: text_secondary.
typography.numbers: Use tabular-nums (monospace) for all pricing, margins, and cost data in tables.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08) for cards and table rows.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Soft ambient shadows for elevated surfaces like dropdowns: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5).
visual_enhancers.badges: Pill-shaped, subtle background tints (e.g., Live: bg-green-900/30 text-green-400).

components.tables: Dense padding (py-2 px-3), sticky headers with surface_charcoal background (never transparent), hover state on rows (bg-white/5).
components.wizard: Multi-step modal/stepper. Use a bento grid of selectable visual cards for the 8 discount patterns instead of a dense dropdown.
components.cards: For offers, use card-based layouts showing Rule Type, Dates, Scope, and Status for easier scannability.

layout_strategies.eoss_planning: Split pane layout: Left panel for configuring Markdown ladder (rules/targets), Right panel for the data table showing generated recommendations (Approve/Reject toggles).
layout_strategies.discount_analytics: High-density dashboard grid. Top row: Summary KPIs. Main area: Split by rule charts and a datatable for Manual override logs (visually flagged).
layout_strategies.price_list: Full-width data table optimized for scanning, with inline filters for Barcode, Brand, and Margin %. Highlight re-ticketing rows with subtle rust borders.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over rust/navy backgrounds has sufficient contrast (use off-white text).
accessibility.interactive: All buttons/links must have clear hover and focus states (ring-2 ring-rust/50).
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Refactor React routing to implement the 3-pillar IA (Price Book, Promotions, Discount Reports).
Convert the existing 5 top-level pages into sub-tabs or views within these 3 sections.
Implement the 'New Offer' authoring flow as a wizard/stepper accessible from the Promotions page.
Ensure all components use .jsx/.js extensions (no TypeScript/TSX).
Maintain the existing dark 'Warm' theme exactly: #1f2d4d navy, #c4623f rust, charcoal backgrounds.
Apply tabular numerals to all tables in Price Book and Reports.
Do not use transparent backgrounds for floating elements like dropdowns, modals, or sticky headers; use solid charcoal (#252830).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Preserve the KDPS Operating System visual identity (Warm dark theme). Avoid AI-slop generic layouts; use dense, professional ERP patterns. Separate Price (base value) from Discount (transient rule) conceptually and visually. Use data-testid on all interactive elements. Follow React best practices for state management across tabs.
